verdicts.claim: Saved BZ/BP arithmetic and reported summaries
verdicts.finding: All 856 published JSON leaves match; every saved raw/stored BZ mean comparison matches. All 120 historical inline printed fields match at their recorded precision.

verdicts.claim: BZ task accuracy advantage of the selected chaotic-labelled arm
verdicts.finding: Arithmetic and MBPP steered arms are floor-limited; NQ accuracy difference includes zero. This is neither equivalence nor evidence of no behavioral differences: the NQ and MBPP entropy contrasts are retained.

verdicts.claim: BP q7 marginal chaos-labelled accuracy association
verdicts.finding: The six q7 all/greedy-subset contrasts are negative. Task composition and measured covariates materially change the comparison; no causal entropy-adjustment direction or calibrated native-chaos effect follows.

No chaotic-labelled prompts occur in either requested subset; both contrasts remain undefined and consume no permutation draws. At 0.32, missing chaotic NQ support also leaves the full task-composition decomposition undefined.

verdicts.claim: Adjusted q7 OLS and entropy-quartile findings
verdicts.finding: All three observed fits and all 15000 permutation fits are finite and rank 5. Empty quartile contrasts and all minimum-count weights remain explicit. Adjustment and transcript order are disclosed retrospective evidence, not a fresh preregistration.
All 39400 saved arithmetic/NQ text comparisons match. The 5400 MBPP correctness flags remain inherited because code was not executed; 181 saved BP NQ prefixes may be truncated.

resampling_inventory.caveat: Manufactured full-shape workload and actual missing-group workload are distinct. Raw zero Monte Carlo exceedance fractions are not exact zero probabilities.

limits: Team-level prior outcome exposure is disclosed; this is independent unblinded saved-data arithmetic, not a fresh confirmatory experiment.
Finite SoftLoop labels are inherited. Ordinary BP generation used float32; float64 label evaluation does not establish float64 native decoding or calibrated native chaotic dynamics.

Original selected-cell construction and hidden/visible subtype classification are inherited where native evidence is unavailable; matching retained selection fields is not a replay of original map selection.
The later producer transcript supplies historical inline code and invocation order as producer attestation, not independent observation of the historical process.
All exact endpoint tables, nonzero composition closure discrepancies, undefined groups, quartet weights, response flags and alternative findings remain in the accepted note and complete presentation.
No causal effect, entropy mediation direction, equivalence, or general behavioral benefit follows from these observational pilot comparisons.

future_fresh_design.requirements: A genuinely fresh cohort with equivalence-aware exclusions; frozen model/revision, population, sampling, scoring, exclusions, support/rank/undefined policy, estimand, uncertainty and resource card before new outcomes. BP/BPC/BPCS results already seen cannot be newly preregistered.
